# Festie

Festie (https://festie.us) is a festival planner web app: browse a festival's
lineup, save Must See / Want to See / Maybe picks, spot clashing set times, and
plan together with your crew. Guests can browse the schedule and previews;
signing in unlocks saved picks, crew planning, and the post-festival Wrap recap.

## Key routes

- /cards — schedule as artist cards (default view)
- /timeline — schedule by time
- /grid — every stage at once
- /picks — your saved picks (sign in required)
- /crew — plan with your crew (sign in required)
- /wrap — post-festival recap (after the festival ends)
- /account — profile and settings
- /login, /register — authentication
